description: This file contains core class definitions for the TestLink project, including abstract classes for managing objects, database interactions, serialization, and attachments. It defines classes such as tl, tlObject, tlObjectWithDB, tlObjectWithAttachments, and tlDBObject, which serve as base classes for various managed entities within the system.

classes.name: tl
classes.description: Abstract class defining constants for status and error codes used throughout the project.

classes.name: tlObject
classes.description: Base class for all managed TestLink objects, supporting serialization, user feedback, and audit configuration.

classes.name: tlObjectWithDB
classes.description: Abstract class extending tlObject, adding database connection management.

classes.name: tlObjectWithAttachments
classes.description: Abstract class extending tlObjectWithDB, supporting attachment management via an attachment repository.

classes.name: tlDBObject
classes.description: Abstract class implementing basic support for database serialization and object caching.

methods.name: setAuditEventSource
methods.description: Sets the source of audit events.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the object.

methods.name: _clean
methods.description: Resets internal data of the object.

methods.name: getSupportedSerializationFormatDescriptions
methods.description: Returns format descriptions for supported serialization interfaces.

methods.name: handleNotImplementedMethod
methods.description: Handles calls to unimplemented methods, returning an error code.

methods.name: getDBTables
methods.description: Returns a map of database table names with optional filtering.

methods.name: getDBViews
methods.description: Returns a map of database view names with optional filtering.
